items.title: Make all six pre-story allocation questions mechanically answerable in the architecture plan
items.context: Extend the normative probe/review schemas, freshness, verdict derivation, story_create ordering, reason codes, rollout and verification matrix with causeClassification, activeStoryAssessment and conflictAssessment. Preserve Q1-Q5 compatibility while making PROCEED require code-change necessity and zero unresolved conflicts.
items.userSees: The decision document contains an explicit six-question proof table and machine-checkable rules showing when to reuse an existing mechanism or Story, perform a non-code recovery, research a conflict, or create a minimal implementation Story.

items.title: Independently re-audit the strengthened six-proof contract
items.context: Run focused Claude CLI and agy CLI reviews over the amended normative sections, reconcile any BLOCKER/HIGH findings, and record the amendment audit without rewriting the historical B-c648 audit record.
